result.description:
Travel Agency Manager

Happy Travels is Australia’s leading backpacker travel agency, built on a passion for adventure and a commitment to creating unforgettable experiences. Despite the challenges faced by the travel industry in recent years, we’ve continued to grow by staying focused on what matters most - our people and our travellers.

We’re more than just a booking service. We’re a tight-knit, energetic team dedicated to helping backpackers and tourists make the most of their time in Australia, Fiji, and New Zealand. From once-in-a-lifetime tours to hidden local gems, we connect travellers with experiences that turn trips into lifelong memories.

At Happy Travels, it’s all about people, connection, and adventure.

Role Overview:

As a Travel Agency Manager, your primary focus will be to oversee the operations of our travel agency, ensuring exceptional service delivery and maximising sales performance. You will lead a team of Travel Sales Consultants, motivating and guiding them to achieve sales targets and provide outstanding customer experiences. A crucial part of your role will be the recruitment, training, and development of staff, ensuring they are equipped with the skills and knowledge to excel in their roles.

Key Responsibilities:
- Leading and overseeing the overall operations and strategic direction of the travel agency.
- Developing and implementing business plans and strategies to achieve company objectives and targets.
- Managing financial aspects, including budgeting, forecasting, and financial performance analysis.
- Building and maintaining relationships with key stakeholders, such as travel suppliers, partners, and clients.
- Analysing market trends and competitor activities to identify opportunities and threats in the industry.
- Recruiting, training, and mentoring staff members to ensure a high level of professionalism and service quality.
- Setting performance goals and KPIs for the team, monitoring progress, and providing guidance as needed.
- Driving sales and revenue growth through effective marketing, pricing strategies, and product offerings.
- Developing and maintaining operational policies, procedures, and standards to ensure efficiency and compliance.
- Handling escalated customer issues and complaints, seeking resolution, and maintaining customer satisfaction.
- Negotiating contracts and agreements with suppliers to secure favourable terms and conditions.
- Staying updated on industry regulations, compliance requirements, and best practices.
- Utilising technology tools and systems to streamline operations and enhance customer experience.
- Analysing data and metrics to evaluate performance, identify areas for improvement, and make informed decisions.
- Representing the company at industry events, conferences, and trade shows to network and promote services.
- Monitoring and managing risk factors, such as safety, security, and legal liabilities, to protect the company’s interests.
- Fostering a positive work culture and environment that encourages teamwork, innovation, and continuous improvement.

Benefits:
- Competitive salary with performance-based incentives and superannuation package.
- Opportunities for career advancement and professional development.
- Travel incentives and familiarisation trips.
- Exclusive discounts on transport and accommodation.
- A supportive and dynamic work environment.

Qualifications:
- 3+ years experience as a travel agency manager or Diploma or Higher plus 1 year of experience.
- Strong leadership skills with the ability to motivate and inspire a team.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
- A passion for travel and a commitment to delivering exceptional customer experiences.
- Experience in staff recruitment, training, and development.
- Multilingual skills are a significant advantage.

Australian Citizens & Permanent Residents are encouraged to apply.

Join the Happy Travels team and lead the way in creating unforgettable experiences for travellers and adventurers. Apply now to become our Travel Agency Manager and embark on a rewarding career journey!

result.description:
RADIAM EARLY LEARNING PTY LTD trading as Sagewood

Woodvale, WA

We believe every child is born with unique talents and gifts that can be nurtured and inspired to give them the best start in life. A child who is loved will flourish in their environment, and feel empowered to choose their own path in life. Sagewood Early Learning has been formed by an experienced team of passionate professionals within the Australian childcare industry. Through a unique blend of learning programs, we deliver bespoke, boutique learning experiences that are personalised to each child. Everything we do is based on our three foundational values — nurture, love, inspire. Creating safe environments where children play, discover, and explore under the guidance of nurturing and passionate educators. Sparking a genuine love of learning — in a loving atmosphere —by encouraging curiosity, imagination, and creativity through all play and activities. Blending credible learning methodologies with Montessori Reggio and Steiner to inspire and equip children as they learn. If this sounds like a company for you, then please send your cover letter and resume outlining the Position you are applying for, whether you are seeking full time or part timework and how your values align to ours.

Qualifications & experience
Current Working with Children Check 
Current National Police Clearance Certificate 
Current approved First Aid Certificate 
and CPR 

Work experience in an early childhood setting. 

A solid understanding of the developmental needs of children aged 0-5years 

Diploma in Childrens services or as recognized by ACECQA 

Montessori Qualifications and or formal training

What makes our centre special

Rated Exceeding under the NQS High staff retention Multicultural centre (promoting diversity and inclusion) 4 Early Childhood Teachers (full time) 8 Montessori Teachers Caring and nurturing approach with many of the staff being parents themselves Afternoon Arts and cultural program including a dedicated Art Teacher Strong community and parent involvement and collaboration 2 Mental health Well Being officers Sustainability officer WHS, First aid officer Incursions and excursions throughout the year.

Tasks & responsibilities
Provide a vibrant, interesting, varied, and appropriate children’s program that is developed and implemented to meet the ongoing needs of the children as per the Early Years Learning Framework. Ensure that the philosophy, policies, and procedures of the company are upheld, implemented and reviewed regularly to meet relevant requirements. Maintain compliance with the regulations as prescribed by the Education and Care Regulatory Unit along with all legal and statutory requirements. Encourage staff and families of Sagewood to actively contribute to the quality and success of the Centre. Ensure that a sense of belonging and respect prevails at the center between children, educators, and families always. Execute the daily operations of the room to ensure an early learning program and care of the highest standard. Respect and provide support and inclusion for all children, regardless of gender, cultural background or socio-economic status. Act as a positive role model, demonstrating appropriate behaviour and language.

Benefits
WA owned and operated Family owned, we understand the importance of family and will treat you like you are our family. Individual contracts based on experience and ability, negotiated rates and conditions for the right applicant Team events, to have fun! work hard play hard and enjoy life Staff discount negotiable Agreed shifts and rosters to enable work life balance Centre is open 7am -5pm Monday to Friday Trainees to support rosters and leave for consistency and continuity Wellbeing support, mental health days, mindfulness, yoga just to name a few Internal and external networking to support knowledge and growth in roles Professional development paid for, including first aid

Salary $75,000 - $80,000 per year

result.description:
Accountant
Location: Parramatta, Sydney NSW
Industry: Business Services & Corporate Advisory (Accounting)
Employment Type: Full-Time, Permanent
Salary: $75,000 – $85,000 per annum + Superannuation

About the Employer
Tax Solutions New South Wales is a growing boutique accounting and advisory firm based in Parramatta. Since 2021, we have delivered high-quality, client-focused solutions across a wide range of accounting disciplines. We support small to medium-sized businesses and individuals with bookkeeping, taxation, business advisory, cash flow forecasting, and external CFO services. Our firm prides itself on accuracy, responsiveness, and personal service.

We are seeking a skilled and motivated Accountant to join our professional team and contribute to delivering expert financial guidance and compliance solutions to our expanding client base.

Key Responsibilities
•	Preparation and lodgment of income tax returns, Business Activity Statements (BAS), and financial statements for individuals, partnerships, companies, and trusts
•	Assisting with tax planning strategies, including GST, CGT, FBT, and Division 7A compliance
•	Conducting bank reconciliations, payroll processing, accounts payable/receivable reviews, and end-of-month journals
•	Liaising directly with clients to provide clear, practical advice and resolve technical queries
•	Supporting the firm’s Principal with documentation and insights for management reporting and client briefings
•	Assisting with external CFO support, including forecasting, budgeting, and financial performance analysis
•	Collaborating with administrative staff and junior team members to ensure timely preparation and submission of financial documentation
•	Ensuring accuracy and compliance with Australian Accounting Standards and ATO regulations

Skills & Qualifications
The ideal candidate will possess:
•	A Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a closely related discipline
•	A minimum of 1–2 years’ experience in public practice accounting in Australia (essential)
•	Sound knowledge of Australian taxation law, GST, and relevant reporting frameworks
•	Demonstrated experience using accounting software platforms (e.g., Xero, MYOB, or QuickBooks)
•	Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and ability to interpret financial data
•	Excellent verbal and written communication skills and a proactive, client-focused attitude
•	Ability to manage time effectively, prioritize tasks, and work both independently and within a small team
•	Intention to pursue or current enrolment in CPA or CA qualification (desirable but not mandatory)

What We Offer
•	Structured training and mentorship from senior professionals
•	Financial and study support for CPA/CA progression
•	A variety of engagements across multiple industries and business structures
•	A flexible working environment including access to the latest accounting tools and systems
•	A friendly, inclusive culture that values collaboration, professional growth, and employee wellbeing
•	Long-term career development with opportunities for progression within the firm

Application Process
This position is open to Australian citizens, permanent residents, and visa holders with full work rights. 
Applications close: 13th August 2026

IT Systems & Support Technician (Industrial Automation)

About our client 

Kogan People Solutions has been retained by a leading automotive components manufacturer to recruit a highly focused tech professional for their automated production facility. Our client operates a state of  the art, continuous manufacturing environment where 100% of finished products undergo sophisticated, computer controlled validation before release. Due to operational expansion and the critical nature of their systems, we are seeking a dedicated IT Systems Support Technician to ensure their core industrial computing infrastructure remains online and optimized.

Role Overview
This is a highly specialized, business-critical role embedded directly within an advanced manufacturing environment. You will be responsible for the continuous, real-time monitoring of two advanced Turbo Test Duo balancing and calibration systems driven by embedded software platforms.

To confirm: This is not a mechanical repair position. The primary objective is the maintenance, troubleshooting, and support of the highly integrated computer systems, hardware interfaces, and proprietary software that governs the physical machinery.

Location: Cheltenham, VIC

Job Type: Full-time, Ongoing 

Salary $80,000 – $90,000 + Superannuation  per annum.

Responsibilities 
•	Actively oversee and analyze the operation of embedded, computer-controlled industrial systems throughout the day.

•	Instantly respond to automated software alerts and digital system alarms to isolate faults across integrated computer hardware and data logging modules.

•	Resolve complex technical issues occurring within specialized proprietary software configurations and peripheral IT components.

•	Manage, verify, and update software profiles, system parameters, and computer calibration data to guarantee operational accuracy.

•	Maintain precise digital records of system errors, technical configurations, and software performance logs to feed into predictive risk management.

Required Skills, Qualifications & Experience

•	Diploma, or higher qualification in a highly related IT discipline or agreed substitute

•	Experience: Minimum of 1–2 years of professional experience supporting integrated computer networks, automated software platforms, or industrial IT hardware interfaces.

•	Proven experience interpreting real-time software diagnostics, system logs, and bi-directional hardware/software integration.

•	Strong ability to diagnose computing faults rapidly under pressure to minimize production downtime. 

•	Excellent communication skills to interface with production engineers.

•	Ability to prioritise, multitask and work independently.

•	A passion for learning and staying ahead of technology trends.

•	Ability to analyse and evaluate complex IT issues.

•	High attention to detail and documentation accuracy

You will have unrestricted rights to work full time in Australia to be considered. 

How to Apply

If you possess the specialized IT skills required to support critical, automated industrial computing infrastructure, Kogan People Solutions wants to hear from you. Accompanying your application, we would prefer to see a cover letter detailing your specific software and hardware troubleshooting experience

Applications

Please respond to the recruiters using the facilities on this site, and ensure you attach your updated CV.

Kogan People Solutions are grateful for all applications, but kindly note that they will only respond to shortlisted applicants.

We help people who have been involved in a car accident by handling all aspects of the claim from providing a replacement car to making sure their car is back on the road in no time.

The opportunity
We’re looking for a proven new-business sales professional who knows how to open doors, build influence, and win share with collision repairers, tow companies, vehicle dealerships and insurance brokers across Melbourne, Victoria.

If you already have strong relationships with repairers, dealers, or automotive referrers, and you’re willing to roll up your sleeves, get your hands dirty, and do what it takes to win and keep business, this role is built for you.

Reporting to the Operations Manager, you will own and grow the Victorian territory, with a primary focus on:
Winning new repairers, tow companies, dealers and insurance brokers
Expanding engagement with existing referrers
Driving sustained revenue growth through disciplined sales activity

This is a field-based, relationship-driven role where success comes from consistent prospecting, face-to-face engagement, and commercial follow-through.

You’ll plan and execute your own sales rhythm, identifying targets, booking visits, educating partners on our value proposition, and converting opportunities into long-term referrer relationships.

This role involves regular travel throughout Victoria to support new and existing accounts. From time to time, you will also travel outside Victoria to support national sales initiatives, key accounts, or strategic opportunities, working closely with the wider team. Importantly, this is not a “stay in the office” sales role. When needed, you will be on the ground supporting operations, including assisting customers, and helping resolve issues in real time. You see this as part of building trust, not someone else’s problem.

What you’ll be doing
Proactively hunting new business with collision repairers, tow companies, dealerships and insurance brokers
Leveraging existing industry relationships to accelerate growth
Building trusted partnerships through regular, structured visits
Positioning us as the preferred mobility partner
Managing your pipeline and activity through CRM with discipline and accuracy
Working closely with internal teams to deliver great outcomes for customers and partners
Travelling throughout Victoria, to support sales growth
Stepping in operationally where required – including customer interactions – to protect relationships and outcomes

What we’re looking for
This role will suit someone who is:
A true sales hunter with a track record of winning new business
Experienced selling into collision repairers, automotive dealerships, insurance brokers, or related automotive services
Well-connected in the Melbourne, Victoria repairer network (highly desirable)
Commercially minded, self-directed, and comfortable working autonomously
Practical, hands-on, and comfortable operating in the real world – not just from a CRM

You’ll also bring a valid driver’s licence with a solid driving record, a willingness to travel regularly as part of the role, strong organisational skills with disciplined follow-up, and a customer-first mindset with the resilience to confidently handle objections and complexity.

What’s in it for you
We believe in recognising great performance and supporting growth opportunities.

You’ll benefit from:
A competitive base salary with a competitive commission structure which is actually achievable, a company vehicle and fuel card
Career development and progression pathways within a growing business
A supportive leadership team that values initiative, results and empowers decision-making

Ready to drive your next chapter?
If you’re ready to lead, grow, and make a meaningful impact, we’d love to hear from you.
Apply today and take the wheel of your next great opportunity.

Employer questions
Your application will include the following questions:
Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in Australia?
What's your expected annual base salary?
How much notice are you required to give your current employer?
Do you have customer service experience?
How many years' experience do you have as a Business to Business Business Development Manager?

Sales Representative (Industrial Products) (Full-Time) – Ausgreen Solar Solutions, NSW & ACT

Job Summary
Ausgreen Solar Solutions is a renewable energy solutions provider operating across New South Wales and the Australian Capital Territory, specialising in the supply of solar panels, inverters, batteries, and energy efficiency products for residential, commercial, and industrial customers. The business provides tailored renewable energy solutions, technical product advice, and professional support to assist customers in adopting efficient and sustainable energy systems.

We are currently seeking a motivated and experienced Sales Representative (Industrial Products) to join our team on a full-time basis. This role is ideal for a technically minded sales professional who enjoys developing business relationships, promoting industrial products, providing product solutions, and achieving sales objectives within a growing renewable energy industry.

Why You'll Love This Role
• Salary: $75,000 – $85,000 per annum plus superannuation
• Location: NSW 2200 & ACT 2601
• Full-time, ongoing position
• Work within a growing renewable energy and industrial products business
• Opportunity to develop expertise in solar and energy efficiency solutions
• Career development opportunities within a growing industry

Key Responsibilities
• Promote and sell industrial renewable energy products, including solar panels, inverters, batteries, and related energy solutions to commercial and industrial customers.
• Identify potential customers and develop new business opportunities through market research, networking, customer enquiries, and sales activities.
• Establish and maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective commercial clients, contractors, and industry stakeholders.
• Assess customer requirements and provide technical product information and suitable solutions based on customer needs.
• Prepare quotations, sales proposals, product specifications, and technical information for customers.
• Negotiate sales agreements, pricing, and product requirements with customers and suppliers.
• Manage customer accounts and maintain regular communication to ensure ongoing customer satisfaction and repeat business opportunities.
• Provide advice regarding product features, benefits, installation requirements, and energy solutions.
• Liaise with internal technical and installation teams to coordinate product delivery and ensure customer requirements are met.
• Monitor market conditions, industry trends, competitor activities, and customer demand to identify new sales opportunities.
• Maintain accurate records of sales activities, customer interactions, and business opportunities.
• Prepare sales reports and provide updates on market opportunities, customer feedback, and sales performance.
• Ensure compliance with company policies, workplace health and safety requirements, and industry standards.

What We're Looking For
• Relevant qualification in sales, business, marketing, engineering, renewable energy, or a related field OR 
• Minimum five year of relevant experience in industrial product sales, technical sales, or business-to-business sales.
• Experience selling technical products or solutions to commercial and industrial customers.
• Strong understanding of sales processes, customer relationship management, and business development.
• Ability to interpret customer requirements and recommend appropriate product solutions.
• Strong negotiation, communication, and presentation skills.
• Ability to build and maintain long-term customer relationships.
• Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple customer accounts and sales activities.
• Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and achieve sales targets.
• Willingness to develop knowledge of solar energy products, renewable technologies, and industrial applications.

How to Apply
11 Recruitment is assisting Ausgreen Solar Solutions with the recruitment process. If you are a dedicated sales professional with experience in industrial products and a passion for renewable energy solutions, we encourage you to apply and take the next step in your sales career.
